# channel.matrix review guide

The branch history is append-only. Reviewability is restored with seven closed
path/invariant slices; no force-push or historical rewrite is required.

For an exact base and head, reviewers derive the first and last touching commit
with `git log --reverse <base>..<head> -- <slice paths>`, then retain the
candidate tree, changed-path list and command receipts as the slice invariant
receipt.
